title: The Brutal Rule Wealthy People Never Break
hook: Poor people trade their time for money. The wealthy buy other people's time.

scenes.text: Poor people trade their time for money. The wealthy buy other people's time.
scenes.visual_prompt: luxury modern penthouse office overlooking skyline at night, glowing glass desk, sleek dark billionaire aesthetic, 8k vertical

scenes.text: If you are the only engine generating your income, you are one illness away from absolute zero.
scenes.visual_prompt: golden mechanical clock gears spinning amidst dark smoke, dramatic luxury lighting, macro vertical shot

scenes.text: Every single dollar you save should not sit in a bank. It must act as an employee deployed to capture more dollars.
scenes.visual_prompt: stacks of crisp currency neatly arranged next to glowing stock charts on dark screen, cinematic lighting, 8k vertical

scenes.text: Build assets that print cash while you sleep, or you will work until the day you die.
scenes.visual_prompt: golden bullion bars gleaming under focused spotlight in high-security bank vault, hyperrealistic 8k vertical wallpaper

scenes.text: Drop a follow if you choose financial freedom over comfort.
